ItemID: NA; Title: Together; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The vocal-group feel appeals to me, but I would check the artist and track list before choosing.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Best ...So Far; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little sense of whether the music fits my taste.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Vocal duets suit my interest in polished singing and the musical-theater feel of Stages.
ItemID: NA; Title: Man Against Machine; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have enjoyed some country music, but right now I want gentler, vocal-focused listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Expressive ballads appeal to me, though I would choose an orchestral vocal album first today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Josh Groban; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Having listened to Stages, I would like to explore more of his rich, melodic singing.
ItemID: NA; Title: Melody Road; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My earlier interest in The Bang Years makes another Neil Diamond album a natural choice.
ItemID: NA; Title: Christmas; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have enjoyed Christmas music, but I am not looking for seasonal listening right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: To Be Loved; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Smooth vocals fit my taste, but Josh Groban and Passione interest me more this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: Passione; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Romantic classical-crossover vocals fit what I enjoy in Amor & Pasion and A Musical Affair.
